Thank you for your patience PH Gyutizens and Inspirits! 🫂

GyutiePH would like to present the ✨fan projects✨ proposed through collecting and compiling the ideas and suggestions by everyone from past events and the recent LV4 in Manila survey form. 😉 

With that, we would also like to present the target amount for each fan project which can be found inside the proposal. As of May 23, 2026, the collected donation for the fan project is ₱7,050.00 which is 8.8% of the total target amount. You can view the breakdown of the items enclosed in the fan project by scanning the QR Code or through the link below👇👇 
🖇️LV4 in Manila Fan Project Proposal: https://t.co/zUYEHcL9JS

Other relevant links can be found below 👇👇
🖇️Oplan: Leap to Vector: https://t.co/c2dWjw842n
🖇️LV4 Donation Transparency Sheet: https://t.co/1a1L1ueht9

Once again, we would like to thank everyone who donated and for the trust given to us.🙇‍♀️🫶 Once fan projects have been approved by the artist management, adjustments will be done accordingly. Donations may close early if target goal is met before ‼️June 20, 2026‼️ We ask for everyone's participation and cooperation to make the final stop of the LV4 Asia tour memorable for both Kim Sunggyu and the fans. 🎉🪩

#LeapToVectorInManila 
#LV4InManila 
#KimSunggyuInManila
